description: Changes one of the caller's open paper positions. Use after arena_state for the id; to end a position use arena_close. kind: claim pays the fees waiting to cash; compound puts them back into the rungs; add puts amountUsd more in, in the position's shape; withdraw takes pct of every rung out to cash; rebalance lays the band again at the price now from plan; auto sets the autopilot rules (take profit, stop loss, re-lay, harvest, compound), run for you like the live pilot. Returns: position (as it stands after the change), cashUsd. Behavior: writes to the account at the pool's price now; the field the kind needs is checked before anything changes. Heavy: costs 3 units and a heavy slot. Errors: refused when the id is not one of the caller's open positions, cash is short for an add, or the kind's field is missing (amountUsd for add, pct for withdraw, plan for rebalance, rules for auto).

amountUsd.description: With kind add: play dollars to put in, from cash.

id.description: The position's id, from arena_state or arena_open.

kind.description: What to do: claim, compound, add, withdraw, rebalance or auto.

pct.description: With kind withdraw: the percent of every rung to take out to cash, 1 to 99.

plan.description: With kind rebalance: the new band and shape, laid at the price now.

fullRange.description: True lays the whole price range instead of the band; lowPct and highPct are then ignored.

highPct.description: the band's top, percent from the price

lowPct.description: the band's bottom, percent from the price (negative)

rungs.description: How many rungs the band is cut into, 1 to 40; default 16.

shape.description: How the money is spread over the rungs: spot (even), curve (most at the price), bidask (most at the edges), hybrid (between), custom (weights); default hybrid.

weights.description: With shape custom: a relative height per rung, low price to high, any scale; resampled to the rung count.

rules.description: With kind auto: the autopilot rules; every rule at 0 or false turns the autopilot off.

autoCompound.description: True puts the fees earned back into the rungs once a day.

followPct.description: Re-lay once the price has drifted this percent from the price the band was laid at, in a direction the rebalance rule allows; 0 off, else 1 to 100.

harvestUsd.description: Claim the fees to cash once they reach this many dollars; 0 off.

rebalance.description: lay the band again once the price has left it: 0 never, 1 after a rise, 2 after a fall, 3 either way

rebalanceFeeBps.description: Re-lay only once the fees earned since the last lay reach this share of the position, in basis points; 0 means at once.

stopLossBps.description: Close the position once its loss reaches this many basis points; 0 off.

takeProfitBps.description: Close the position once its gain reaches this many basis points; 0 off.

name: arena_edit
title: Change a paper position
